8:1.text: about the spoils of war. Say: "The spoils are for Allâh and the Messenger." So fear Allâh and adjust all matters of difference among you, and obey Allâh and His Messenger

8:2.text: The believers are only those who, when Allâh is mentioned, feel a fear in their hearts and when His Verses
increase their Faith; and they put their trust in their Lord

8:3.text: and spend out of that We have provided them.

8:4.text: It is they who are the believers in truth. For them are grades of dignity with their Lord, and Forgiveness and a generous provision

8:5.text: to go out from your home with the truth; and verily, a party among the believers disliked it,

8:6.text: Disputing with you concerning the truth after it was made manifest, as if they were being driven to death, while they were looking

8:7.text: (of the enemy i.e. either the army or the caravan)
that it should be yours; you wished that the one not armed
should be yours, but Allâh willed to justify the truth by His Words and to cut off the roots of the disbelievers

8:8.text: That He might cause the truth to triumph and bring falsehood to nothing, even though the Mujrimûn
